nodes.label: endotoxin
props: Liposaccharide natural compounds consisting of a trisaccharide repeating unit (two heptose units and octulosonic acid) with oligosaccharide side chains and 3-hydroxytetradecanoic acid units (they are a major constituent of the cell walls of Gram-negative bacteria).

nodes.label: LBP
props: Plays a role in the innate immune response. Binds to the lipid A moiety of bacterial lipopolysaccharides (LPS), a glycolipid present in the outer membrane of all Gram-negative bacteria.

nodes.label: CD14
props: My23 antigen; Myeloid cell-specific leucine-rich glycoprotein

Coreceptor for bacterial lipopolysaccharide. In concert with LBP, binds to monomeric lipopolysaccharide and delivers it to the LY96/TLR4 complex, thereby mediating the innate immune response to bacterial lipopolysaccharide (LPS).
Cell membrane, Secreted, Membrane raft, Golgi apparatus

references.title: Toll-like Receptors and the Control of Immunity.
Chronic fine particulate matter exposure induces systemic vascular dysfunction via NADPH oxidase and TLR4 pathways.

nodes.label: TIRAP
props: Adaptor protein Wyatt; MyD88 adapter-like protein

Adapter involved in TLR2, TLR4 and RAGE signaling pathways in the innate immune response. Acts via IRAK2 and TRAF-6, leading to the activation of NF-kappa-B, MAPK1, MAPK3 and JNK, and resulting in cytokine secretion and the inflammatory response.

nodes.label: MYD88
props: Myeloid differentiation primary response protein MyD88

Adapter protein involved in the Toll-like receptor and IL-1 receptor signaling pathway in the innate immune response. Acts via IRAK1, IRAK2, IRF7 and TRAF6, leading to NF-kappa-B activation, cytokine secretion and the inflammatory response.

nodes.label: IRAK4
props: Serine/threonine-protein kinase that plays a critical role in initiating innate immune response against foreign pathogens. Involved in Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling pathways.

references.title: Phosphoinositide-mediated adaptor recruitment controls Toll-like receptor signaling.
Helical assembly in the MyD88-IRAK4-IRAK2 complex in TLR/IL-1R signalling.
An oligomeric signaling platform formed by the Toll-like receptor signal transducers MyD88 and IRAK-4.
